issues.description: The SPARQL constraint for IA Super ships uses the prefix `nltl` without an explicit PREFIX declaration inside the query, causing an unknown namespace prefix error during validation.
issues.suggestion: Add an explicit `PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>` line at the beginning of the `sh:select` query (or ensure the SHACL engine imports the declared prefixes for SPARQL queries).

issues.description: The SPARQL constraint for IA, IB, and IC ships also uses the prefix `nltl` without an explicit PREFIX declaration inside the query, leading to the same unknown namespace prefix error.
issues.suggestion: Add an explicit `PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>` line at the beginning of this `sh:select` query (or ensure the SHACL engine imports the declared prefixes for SPARQL queries).
